| colspan="10" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small>
{{refbegin}}
{{note|immunity|<small>1</small>}} <small>As the first place finisher of their respective Immunity challenges, Loïc and Clémence earned the right to gift Immunity to someone from the opposite tribe. They respectively chose Alexandra and Maxime.</small><br />
{{note|idol|<small>2</small>}} <small>An Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.</small><br />
{{note|reward|<small>3</small>}} <small>For the first half of the third Reward challenge, both tribes competed as teams. The last part of the challenge was individual : two castaways from each tribe would qualify. Among those four, the first three to complete an individual challenge earned themselves reward.</small><br />
{{note|rival_immunity|<small>4</small>}} <small>At the Immunity Challenge, the winning tribe was able to grant Indvidual Immunity to a castaway from the losing tribe.</small><br />
{{note|tie|<small>5</small>}} <small>Tribal Council resulted in a tie. Per the rules, a second vote was held where the castaways could only vote for those involved in the tie.</small><br />
{{note|ambassadors|<small>6</small>}} <small>At the ambassadors meeting, the four ambassadors agreed to vote Coumba out of the game.</small><br />
{{note|amulet|<small>7</small>}} <small>As victors of the last Duel of the Banished, both Clémence and Ugo had an Immunity Amulet, able to negate votes on a castaway at the first merge Tribal Council. Clémence used hers on Alix, negating seven votes against her.</small><br />
{{note|suddendeath4|<small>8</small>}} <small>The castaway who finished last in the Sudden Death Challenge would be eliminated from the main game.</small><br />
{{note|tieddestinies|<small>9</small>}} <small>Teheiura was Christelle's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore he was also eliminated when Christelle was voted out.</small><br />
{{note|ejection|<small>10</small>}} <small>Teheiura was ejected from Exile Island after being discovered getting food from local fishermen to camp.</small><br />
{{note|finaltwo|<small>11</small>}} <small>Because of many instances of cheating from Claude and Laurent, Claude's victory was revoked and neither were crowned the Sole Survivor. The prize money was donated to a charity in remembrance of [[Bertrand-Kamal Loudrhiri]].</small><br />
{{refend}}
|}
